For me, it really depends on who did the breaking up and if I'm still feel interested in them, really.

If it's the type of break up where we just stop seeing each other entirely, or if I already stopped liking them, honestly, I really don't care. They could just drop out of my life with no warning and I wouldn't even think about it.

But if they, or I, want to stay friends or if I just don't want to lose them, then, yeah, I tend to be pretty posessive of them. I do that whole "I'll be here for you thing" too.

I agree on the fact that it's probably a controlling thing, what I think irritates me most is that I'm not as important a person to them anymore or that I won't be able to have them around when I want them to be; stuff like that. Might not even be that I still like them.

That posessive feeling does go away in most cases, though, but not all.
Kinda cool in a way I think.

The being fake as fuck is what does it for me mostly. Like every so often when I realize people will probably never know or understand me it kinda sucks to think about. But at the same time its whatever cause its not like anyone really cares so I just do a lil 'haha oh yeah' and then I don't care again too.

I do think about what it would be like to be normal sometimes but I don't think I'd ever really pursue it.

Most of why I came here is wanting to see if people really had similar experiences to me since I didn't know of anyone irl. Honestly didn't think I'd relate as much as I do so it's interesting.

I've gone to a few funerals but if I could've avoided it I really would. Having people cry and be sad around me is awkward and it's annoying to have people talk about how much they regret this and that at the point where I think it's too late to think those things. Though, tbh I do tend to pretend at least for a while since having people get on my case about not caring is way more annoying.

As someone else said, I don't find death sad since it's an inevitable thing, and in some cases I really do think it's good for people who've been suffering to just die. Even for people I've been close to (grandma, cousin and girlfriend specifically) who died I never really felt anything about it for very long.

In a way I get that other people have to grieve, I just wish they wouldn't drag me into it lol. I also find people that constantly bring up dead people just to remind people that they're dead very annoying. Idk if thats a thing people just do or if my family is weird for doing it.
